summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Staff Coverage Management System. Backend APIs working perfectly (8/8 tests passed). Frontend functionality mostly working with 14/15 features working correctly. One minor issue found with coverage status update display.

ui_bugs.issue: Coverage status not visually updating immediately after assignment in calendar grid
ui_bugs.details: Assignment works correctly (backend updates), but calendar grid doesn't refresh to show new status colors immediately

design_issues.issue: Missing Description warning in console for DialogContent
design_issues.details: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

passed_tests: All 8 backend API endpoints working correctly
Dashboard displays correct statistics (total, complete, incomplete coverage)
Dashboard shows urgent gaps list with proper data
Calendar view displays all houses and days of January 2025
Calendar cells show coverage status with correct colors (complete/incomplete)
Filters work correctly (by house, by status)
Assignment modal opens when clicking on coverage cells
Staff can be assigned to coverage entries through the modal
Gaps view shows all incomplete coverage entries grouped by house
Staff management page displays all 35 staff members organized by type and subtype
Staff cards show correct information (name, subtype, work schedule, house)
Navigation between pages works correctly via sidebar
Spanish text is displayed correctly throughout the application
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor fix needed: Calendar grid should refresh immediately after staff assignment to show updated coverage status colors. Also consider adding aria-describedby to AssignmentModal for better accessibility.
